name: Fruity Slider
description: Full-screen flavor slider with colored slides, a giant fitted flavor name, a floating drink can and scattered fruit that drops in on each change. Circular pulsing arrows and arrow keys navigate.
contents: Slides, each with flavor name, background color, accent color, can image and fruit image
Scattered floating fruit images per slide at configurable spots
Previous and next round buttons with pulsing wave
behavior: Slide strip translates horizontally between flavors
Name, can and fruit animate in with GSAP on each change, fruit drops from above
Fruit drifts randomly and the can bobs in a loop
Flavor name font size is fitted to the container width and height on resize
Arrow keys left and right change slide
On screens under 640px the buttons move to the bottom and shrink
editableByProps: Number of slides, names, images, alt text and slide colors
Slide transition speed, button size and pulse speed, button labels

needsCodeEdit.where: text-white class on the h1 with data-name
h-[58vh] class on the img with data-can-img

fixed: Listens to arrow keys on window while mounted and removes the listener on unmount
Navigation buttons use fixed positioning relative to the viewport
Uses the Lexend font through next/font/google
Slide count must stay at least 1
